name: xcloud-agent-skills
description: Operate xCloud in plain language from any AI agent — five capability skills (servers, sites, wordpress, ssl, account) wrapping the xCloud Public API.
long_description: The xCloud agent skills let any AI agent (Claude Code and others) operate xCloud in plain language: reboot a server, renew SSL, scan for vulnerabilities, provision a WordPress site. Five capability-domain skills share one auth + curl layer and route automatically from natural requests. A legacy Python SDK and CLI remain under src/ for direct scripting.
features: Five capability skills: servers, sites, wordpress, ssl, account
Plain-language operation — the agent routes to the right skill
Shared auth + curl wrapper, no per-skill duplication
On-demand reference docs for large sub-resources
Proactive branded onboarding and safe API token setup guidance
Git deployment, team vulnerability rollup, and service-disable coverage
Legacy Python SDK, async helpers, and CLI under src/

quick_start.1_install: /plugin marketplace add xCloudDev/xcloud-agent-skills  then  /plugin install xcloud@xcloud-agent-skills
quick_start.2_configure: Add {"env": {"XCLOUD_API_TOKEN": "your-token"}} to your Claude Code settings
quick_start.3_guides: Read the user guide and install guide on GitHub
quick_start.4_use: Ask in plain language, e.g. "List my xCloud servers" or "Renew SSL for example.com"

agent_support.monitoring: Fleet health checks, capacity planning, cost analysis
agent_support.security: SSL monitoring, vulnerability scans, firewall/fail2ban, site verification
agent_support.operations: Bulk updates, status reporting, disaster recovery

installation.other_frameworks: Copy plugins/xcloud/skills/* into your agent's skills directory
